Definition: Abinadab, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"; 1) a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark; 2) second son of Jesse, David's older brother; 3) a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
